title: Which platforms support Billing & Revenue Management?
context: We are reviewing the application landscape supporting retail and billing ahead of the CC&B migration.
request: List the application platforms (APP-DAP) that support the Retail & Billing capability (CAP-006) and its level-2 sub-capabilities, and flag any capability with no supporting platform.
findings:
## Retail & Billing Platform Coverage

### Overview

The Retail & Billing capability (CAP-006) is decomposed into five level-2 sub-capabilities, each with varying platform support. As at version 1.0.0, four of five sub-capabilities have platform support; one has no supporting platform.

### Capability-to-Platform Mapping

| Sub-capability | ID | Description | Supporting Platforms |
|---|---|---|---|
| Manage Tariffs & Products | CAP-006-01 | Design and price retail energy products and tariffs | PLAT-TARIFF-ENGINE |
| Read & Validate Meters | CAP-006-02 | Capture, validate, and estimate meter readings | PLAT-MDM, PLAT-HES |
| Generate Bills | CAP-006-03 | Produce accurate, timely customer bills | PLAT-CIS |
| Collect Payment | CAP-006-04 | Receive payment and manage payment methods | PLAT-CIS |
| Manage Arrears | CAP-006-05 | Handle late payment, customer financial difficulty, and recovery | ⚠️ **No supporting platform** |

### Platform Details

**PLAT-CIS** (Customer Information System) — System-of-record in the Retail & Billing domain. Hosts the customer, account, and contract master plus the billing engine; supports both bill generation (CAP-006-03) and payment collection (CAP-006-04).

**PLAT-TARIFF-ENGINE** (Tariff & Pricing Engine) — System-of-record. Handles tariff modelling, pricing, and rating for CAP-006-01.

**PLAT-MDM** (Meter Data Management) — System-of-record in the Metering domain. Validates, estimates, and edits meter reads; maintains the metering point register; supports CAP-006-02.

**PLAT-HES** (Head-End System) — System-of-record in the Metering domain. Manages smart-meter communications and command-and-control; also supports CAP-006-02.

### Gap Analysis

**CAP-006-05 (Manage Arrears)** is currently unsupported by any mapped platform. This capability covers late payment handling, customer financial difficulty management, and recovery — activities typically embedded in CIS or standalone collections systems. Given the CC&B migration context, this is a critical gap to address during platform selection and implementation.

### Recommendation

Confirm that CAP-006-05 will be supported by the CC&B replacement or identify a dedicated collections/arrears management platform during the migration.
